summary: The active Cycle 1 core, matched-input generator, spatial metrics and server-only runner now exist. Code alignment remains blocked on formal stationarity diagnostics, E3 holdout-family generation, job manifests and server preflight.

covered: ESRI ASCII and binary grid loading
exact-histogram matched landscape generation and audit
independent terrain force switch and scale
independent terrain production switch and scale

missing: fixed-parameter lock between development and holdout stages

blocking_findings.finding: The runner averages a fixed number of final snapshots but does not yet implement the preregistered drift, integrated-autocorrelation-time and effective-sample-size stationarity gate.
blocking_findings.required_action: Implement a machine-checkable stationarity report that can block claim analysis.

blocking_findings.finding: E3 does not yet generate distinct preregistered holdout landscape families or enforce a parameter lock.
blocking_findings.required_action: Add correlated-random-field holdouts and a hashed parameter-lock artifact before E3 can be submitted.

blocking_findings.finding: No versioned research/jobs manifests exist for E0-E3, so deterministic preflight cannot run.
blocking_findings.required_action: Create manifests after the implementation commit, bind source checksums and run preflight on umi.

blocking_findings.finding: The active core compiles locally and unit tests pass, but no build or smoke validation has run on umi.
blocking_findings.required_action: Build with the server compiler and execute only a non-claim smoke validation after commit and preflight.

non_blocking_assets: The engine accepts explicit initial-condition CSV files, so non-degenerate wealth perturbations can be preregistered.
The engine accepts arbitrary ASCII terrain grids, so exact matched landscapes can be generated outside the simulator.
Configuration supports fixed population by disabling reproduction and setting mortality mechanisms to zero or off.
Output directories are configurable and can be kept inside each job workspace.
Random seeds and time step are configurable.
implementation_order: Implement stationarity diagnostics and a parameter-lock artifact.
Add E3 holdout landscape families and cross-scale aggregation.
Create job manifests, bind the real commit, and run preflight on umi before any numerical execution.
